name: knorr Thick tomato soup
ingredients_raw: Sugar, Maize Starch, Tomato Paste Solids (15%), Refined Wheat Flour (Maida), lodised salt, Hydrogenated Palm Oil, *Dehydrated Vegetables (Onion Powder (2.8%), Leeks (1.1%)), Hydrolyzed Vegetable Protein, Spices & Condiments (Black pepper (0.4%)), Anti caking agent - 551, Thickener - 415, Red Beet Juice Powder (Anti caking agent - 551), Flavours - Natural (Garlic) and Nature Identical Flavouring Substances, Flavour Enhancer - 627 & 631, Oleoresin Chilli, Acidity Regulator - 330. Contains Wheat. May Contain Traces of Milk, Mustard, Soya, Celery & Nuts.
